name: Segment
label: Segment HTTP Tracking API — identify, track, page, screen, group, alias
description: Segment HTTP Tracking API v1 at {data_plane_url}/v1. Docs: https://segment.com/docs/connections/sources/catalog/libraries/server/http-api/. identify/track/page/screen/group/alias use official userId, event, properties, traits. Basic auth write_key. Handler: OfficialApiNode. Never log write_key.
author: 5c8b0d45-1d10-4f2e-844c-2318af96b2fa

ports.name: input
ports.description: Per-operation fields. Do not put secrets (write_key) here. Example: {"operation":"track"}.

schema.label: operation
schema.description: Overrides config operation when non-blank. EXACT: 'identify' | 'track' | 'page' | 'screen' | 'group' | 'alias'.

schema.label: userId
schema.description: Your user id. Required on alias; identify/track/page/screen/group need userId or anonymousId. Example: user-42.

schema.label: anonymousId
schema.description: Anonymous id when userId is unknown. identify/track/page/screen/group.

schema.label: event
schema.description: Event name for track. Required. Example: Order Completed.

schema.label: properties
schema.description: Official properties object for track / page / screen. Event-specific keys (revenue, path, url, title). Example: {"revenue":25,"currency":"USD"}.

schema.label: traits
schema.description: Official traits object for identify / group (email, name, plan).

schema.label: previousId
schema.description: alias previousId (old userId). Required with userId.

schema.label: timestamp
schema.description: ISO-8601 timestamp on all calls. Server time when omitted.

schema.label: context
schema.description: Official context object (ip, userAgent, page, campaign).

ports.name: output
ports.description: Success: status=ok, http_status, data (provider JSON). Errors raise a BPMN error for the error boundary event (INVALID_INPUT, AUTH_FAILED, RATE_LIMITED, HTTP_<status>, REQUEST_FAILED); secrets are redacted.

schema.label: data
schema.description: Provider JSON. PII may be present — do not log bodies.

configurationParameters.label: Operation
configurationParameters.description: Default operation when input.operation is blank. EXACT: identify | track | page | screen | group | alias.

configurationParameters.label: Write key
configurationParameters.description: Segment source write key (StudioQuack secret). Official: JSON writeKey or Basic write_key: (empty password). This node uses HTTP Basic. Never log or place on INPUT.

configurationParameters.label: Data plane URL
configurationParameters.description: Tracking API origin used as `{data_plane_url}/v1`. Default https://api.segment.io (Oregon). EU Business: https://events.eu1.segmentapis.com. No trailing slash.

configurationParameters.label: Timeout (seconds)
configurationParameters.description: Per-request HTTP timeout. Positive number; <=0 uses api_spec default. Keep below the daemon invoke budget.
